_comment: Example estate for examples/estate_risk.py. Replace with your own inventory. Times are in years. Each channel is a server/caller pair; data on the read path moves server -> caller. configs are measured session shares by key exchange: 'classical' (X25519, ECDHE, RSA: broken at T_Q), 'hybrid' (e.g. X25519MLKEM768: broken at max(T_Q, T_PQ)), 'broken' (already broken classically). O = probability an adversary records the channel; t_fix = years until migrated; H = years of traffic already recorded on it.
